# Jo's goals, Oct 20, in Jo's order

Jo confirmed these on Oct 20 at about 10:45 AM PDT: "yes, but change their order it gos - work flows, spend less, and then graham, mike, and dan". Plumb split goal 3 into two goals, following Jo's question "isnt them being able to install it a separate goal from it working for neurodivergent pepple?".

`plumb-rank/rank.ts` reads every `goal:` line verbatim. Jev scores each open ticket on each goal from 0 to 3. All goals count equally (Jo, Oct 20: "forget the weighting"); the order records Jo's priority but does not change scores. The ticket's best goal match makes up 30% of its rank score.

goal: Work flows to main without Jo babysitting it: a fast test runner, a merge train that doesn't stall, stuck lanes caught by machinery, and Jo never asked twice.
goal: Spend less per unit of work: cost-conscious model routing, with Fable used only where it earns its price, inside a limited weekly plan.
dropped (Jo, Oct 20 ~11:01 AM: "the stuff that supports graham and daniel installing it? that isn't as important to me" ... "definitely top 10"): Graham, Mike and Dan can install as2 and get it running on their own machines. Not scored; the sharing readiness ticket (#168) is kept at 10th by hand.
goal: as2 works well for neurodivergent people: the way it talks, asks and reports fits an AuDHD reader.
